== ======================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Dr. Anshuman
 Oral Order
15 13-07-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the land of petitioners was acquired for the purpose of construction of Ash Dike-Pipe line and extension of new unit of Muzaffarpur Thermal Power Station Kanti in District- Muzaffarpur bearing Revenue P.S. No.57.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that Patna High Court CWJC No.20116 of 2016(15)
dt.13-07-2023 admittedly the notification has been published on 15.11.2011.
Counsel further submits that it has been admitted in paragraph-6 of the supplementary counter affidavit.

It has been admitted by the Land Acquisition Officer that award has been prepared on 21.06.2016 annexed as Chandeshwar Chaudhary And Ors vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 13 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64151825/
1 Annexure- G of supplementary counter affidavit.

entities.text: Chandeshwar Chaudhary And Ors vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 13 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Counsel for the petitioners further submits that on the basis of admission made by the answering respondent no.4 (District Land Acquisition Officer)
the categorical instruction laid down under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as 'RFCTLARRA, 2013') [Act No. 30 of 2013] is applicable and petitioners are entitled for payment of compensation under the RFCTLARRA, 2013.
3.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the State submits that the counter affidavit itself shows that notification was published in the year 2011 and award was prepared in 2016, as such as per law particularly section 24(2) of the RFCTLARRA, 2013, the petitioners are entitled to be treatment under new law.
4.

In this background, petitioners are directed to file representation before the District Land Acquisition Officer, Muzaffarpur, who shall calculate the compensation in Patna High Court CWJC No.20116 of 2016(15) dt.13-07-2023 accordance with new Act i.e. RFCTLARRA, 2013 within eight weeks from the date of filing a fresh representation before him and assure the payment at the earliest.
5. With the aforesaid direction, the present writ petition is hereby disposed off.

(Dr. Anshuman, J.) ravishankar/-
